peers.name: media-use
peers.description: Get or make any media for a HyperFrames video - music, sound effects, images, icons, logos, voiceover, avatar and generated video, transcripts, cutouts, colour grades and looks - with HeyGen or free local tools, and mix placed audio. Also for footage that looks dark, flat or dull, or should be stylized or hidden.

peers.name: hyperframes-registry
peers.description: About 450 ready-made HyperFrames blocks and components installed as editable source - transitions, overlays, titles, kinetic type, captions, charts, map overlays, 3D, camera moves. Use it before hand-building any named visual (CRT scanlines, glitch, film grain, a chart); also for hyperframes add and catalog.

peers.name: slideshow
peers.description: Build a HyperFrames slideshow to present live - slides, fragment reveals, branching hotspots and presenter mode with speaker notes, served by `hyperframes present` - or turn an existing page into one. Use when the person wants a deck or presentation rather than a rendered video.

peers.name: hyperframes
peers.description: Read first to make, edit, animate or render any video with HyperFrames (HTML rendered to video), including launch films, explainers, music videos, charts, maps, vertical clips, title cards, captions and overlays. Holds the render contract, the work loop and what each kind of video needs.

en.tagline: Work on HyperFrames video projects from the CLI
en.summary: This skill gives an agent the HyperFrames command line for video projects. It covers scaffolding, checks, timeline edits, preview, render, share and project history. It also explains how to read `--json` output and recover from failed commands.
problem: Making a HyperFrames video takes many commands in a set order: create the project, lint it, run the checks, look at frames, preview and render. Without a fixed order, an agent can skip a check or render a file it has not looked at.
With this skill, the agent follows a defined loop. It fixes check errors before rendering, reads snapshot images to see the result, and uses the listed fix for each kind of failure.
fit: Starting a HyperFrames video from a blank project or a captured URL
Changing clip timing in an existing project and undoing the change
Rendering locally, in a container, in batches, or on hosted or your own AWS or GCP setup
unfit: Projects that do not use HyperFrames
Tasks where the person asks you to run the project's own scripts or wrapper, since the skill says not to unless they name that command
steps: Write the composition, then run `npx hyperframes lint` after the first pass and after structural changes.
Run `npx hyperframes check --json` and fix every error before going on.
Run `npx hyperframes snapshot` and read the PNG files to see how the video looks.
Run `npx hyperframes preview --background`, confirm the URL returns 200, and give the project URL to the person.
Render with `npx hyperframes render --quality looks -o out.mp4`, then confirm the file is not empty and check its duration and size with ffprobe.

zh.tagline: 用命令行搭建、检查、编辑和渲染 HyperFrames 视频
zh.summary: 这个技能为智能体提供 HyperFrames 的命令行工具，用于视频项目。它涵盖项目初始化、检查、时间线编辑、预览、渲染、分享和项目历史。它还说明如何读取 `--json` 输出，以及命令失败后如何恢复。
problem: 制作 HyperFrames 视频需要按固定顺序执行许多命令：创建项目、lint、检查、查看画面、预览和渲染。如果顺序不固定，智能体可能跳过某项检查，或者渲染一个它没有看过的文件。
使用这个技能后，智能体会按既定流程操作：渲染前先修复检查报错，通过快照图片确认画面效果，遇到失败时按说明中对应的修复方法处理。
fit: 从空白项目或抓取的网页地址开始制作 HyperFrames 视频
在现有项目中调整片段时间，并能撤销修改
在本地、容器中、批量，或在托管服务、自有 AWS 或 GCP 环境中渲染
unfit: 不使用 HyperFrames 的项目
用户要求运行项目自带脚本或包装命令的任务。技能说明规定，除非用户指明该命令，否则不要运行
steps: 编写合成内容，首轮完成后以及结构变动后运行 `npx hyperframes lint`。
运行 `npx hyperframes check --json`，把所有错误修复后再继续。
运行 `npx hyperframes snapshot`，阅读生成的 PNG 文件，查看视频实际效果。
运行 `npx hyperframes preview --background`，确认地址返回 200，并把项目地址告知用户。
用 `npx hyperframes render --quality looks -o out.mp4` 渲染，然后确认文件不为空，并用 ffprobe 检查时长和尺寸。
